name: Crypto Watchlist
description: Compact Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana market snapshot in USD.
template:
<Stack gap="sm">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap">
    <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <Text fw={700} size="sm">Crypto watchlist</Text>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">USD · 24-hour market</Text>
    </Stack>
    <RefreshButton requestId="quotes" label="Refresh" />
  </Group>
  {status.quotes?.loading ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Loading market data…</Text> : status.quotes?.error ? <Text size="sm" c="red">{status.quotes.statusText ?? "Market data unavailable"}</Text> : (data.quotes?.data ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No market data returned.</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{(data.quotes?.data ?? []).map((asset) => <Stack key={asset.id} gap="xs">
    <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap">
      <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Text fw={700} size="sm" truncate>{asset.name}</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{asset.symbol}{asset.cmc_rank ? ` · #${asset.cmc_rank}` : ""}</Text>
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap={2} align="flex-end">
        <Text fw={700} size="sm">${asset.quote?.[0]?.price?.toFixed(2) ?? "—"}</Text>
        <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color={(asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h ?? 0) >= 0 ? "teal" : "red"}>{(asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h ?? 0) > 0 ? "+" : ""}{(asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h ?? 0).toFixed(2)}%</Badge>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap">
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Cap <Text span fw={600} c="dimmed">${(asset.quote?.[0]?.market_cap ?? 0) >= 1000000000000 ? Math.round(((asset.quote?.[0]?.market_cap ?? 0) / 1000000000000) * 100) / 100 + "T" : Math.round(((asset.quote?.[0]?.market_cap ?? 0) / 1000000000) * 10) / 10 + "B"}</Text></Text>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">24h vol <Text span fw={600} c="dimmed">${(asset.quote?.[0]?.volume_24h ?? 0) >= 1000000000000 ? Math.round(((asset.quote?.[0]?.volume_24h ?? 0) / 1000000000000) * 100) / 100 + "T" : Math.round(((asset.quote?.[0]?.volume_24h ?? 0) / 1000000000) * 10) / 10 + "B"}</Text></Text>
    </Group>
    {asset.id !== 5426 ? <Divider /> : null}
  </Stack>)}</Stack>}
  <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>Updated {data.quotes?.status?.timestamp ?? data.quotes?.data?.[0]?.last_updated ?? "—"}</Text>
</Stack>
